definitions.explanation: A regular or valued customer or business client, especially one with an ongoing relationship.

examples.japanese: {得意先|とくいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{得意先|とくいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Developing new clients is this year's goal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得意先|とくいさき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{信頼関係|しんらいかんけい}→信頼関係：16095_shinraikankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: We value the relationships of trust we have with our long-standing clients.

notes:
Combines ⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧ (valued customer; one's forte) and ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (destination, party). A business term referring to regular customers or clients with whom a company has an established relationship. The nuance is of a valued, ongoing commercial relationship rather than a one-time buyer.

USAGE:
- Primarily used in business contexts
- Implies a B2B (business-to-business) or professional relationship more often than individual consumers
- {得意先|とくいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to make the rounds of clients) is a very common expression for sales visits

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {得意先|とくいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to visit clients
- {得意先|とくいさき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to develop new clients
- {得意先|とくいさき}{回|まわ}り: client visits, sales rounds
- {大口|おおぐち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得意先|とくいさき}: major client

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧: customer, client — more formal; used broadly in business
- ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧: customer — general; used in shops and service contexts
- ⟦クライアント→クライアント：04876_kuraianto⟧: client — loanword; common in creative and consulting industries
- ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧: business partner, trading partner — broader; includes suppliers as well as customers
